# Harbour Point Gym Membership Rules

## 1. Membership types
Harbour Point Gym offers three membership types. The Basic plan costs 29 EUR per month and includes access to the
gym floor between 06:00 and 22:00. The Plus plan costs 45 EUR per month and adds unlimited group classes.
The Student plan costs 19 EUR per month and requires a valid student card.

## 2. Guests
Plus members may bring one guest per month free of charge. Additional guest passes cost 8 EUR each.
Basic members cannot bring guests.

## 3. Freezing a membership
A membership can be frozen for a minimum of 2 weeks and a maximum of 3 months per calendar year.
A freeze request must be submitted at least 5 days before the freeze starts.
